title: OUF Gateway Authorization Context v1
description: Minimal audit/security context propagated from Gateway to backend owner; bearer tokens are not application data.
x-ouf-scope-control: Gateway boundary/runtime contracts only. No Query Complexity Governor, fine-grained data authorization, Durable ACK authority, schema-drift classification, ETL, semantic processing, Object Resolution, UDP materialization, THS decision logic or MCP Server implementation.
x-ouf-invariants: fine-grained authorization is re-evaluated by backend owner
cluster origin alone is never trusted
token or full sensitive application payload is not propagated as audit metadata
